name: vansrouter
description: Vansrouter CLI - Start and manage Vansrouter server
comment_name: DO NOT rename this package back to 9router. It must remain vansrouter to match the global updater configuration (see UPDATER_CONFIG in src/shared/constants/config.js). Changing this causes update loops and data mismatches.
comment_sqlite: sql.js is bundled here, including sql-wasm.wasm, as the offline fallback. better-sqlite3 is installed into ~/.9router/runtime/node_modules lazily by cli.js when the server starts, avoiding an install-time native build.
comment_systray: systray2 is NOT bundled here. It is lazy-installed into ~/.9router/runtime/node_modules only when tray mode is requested on macOS/Linux. Windows uses PowerShell NotifyIcon (zero binary). This avoids shipping unsigned Go binaries that trigger antivirus false positives (Kaspersky). We use the systray2 fork because the legacy systray@1.0.5 ships a 2017 x86_64 binary that fails on modern macOS dyld.
author: Vanszs
